function.name: supermarket_find_in_city
function.description: Find all supermarkets in a given city. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

city.description: The city to locate supermarkets in.

state.description: The state to further narrow down the search.

openNow.description: If true, returns only supermarkets that are currently open. Default to true

function.name: sightseeing_popular_in_city
function.description: Find the most popular sightseeing place in a given city. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

state.description: The state to further narrow down the search.

kidsFriendly.description: If true, returns only kids friendly sightseeing places.Default to true
